g.text: Gravitational lensing — 10 photon trajectories (with per-step dots)
Start (0, 0, -1000). Ten directions tilted in the x-z plane with impact parameter b = 1000·sin(α).
Shader constants: kRs=100, kStepMin=2, kStepMax=50, kStepFar=300, kFarFieldRadius=1125, kMaxRadius=2000.
Each dot = one RK4 step. Dot density inversely proportional to GetStepSize(pos, vel).
